turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm buying a new mattress and I've narrowed it down.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a firm memory foam mattress that a lot of reviews say is great for back pain.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a soft pillow top spring mattress, really cozy, but it might sag after a few years.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's a hybrid with springs and foam, medium firm, and a bit more expensive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The hybrid is often a good balance of support and comfort, and medium firm suits most sleepers. The firm foam one is worth a look if your back hurts. The pillow top feels lovely in the store but may not last as long.
